files.name: ShoreClimbOut.java

help: After shore gets stuck: swim by hand to nearby visible dry ground, dig the bank lip if blocked, turn on stalls
lesson: Shore STUCK is the pathed swim pinned against a bank it can't jump onto; offering on just lastSkill=shore+STUCK while main is shore (no extra preconditions) makes sure the fallback actually runs.
summary: shore_climb_out: after shore fails STUCK/TIMEOUT, swim by hand to a visible dry spot within 5 blocks, digging out the bank lip on a stall and switching targets/turning on repeat stalls.
